_readme: Optional. Only list photographs that need something better than the default.
Keys are the photo id: the filename without its extension (DSC01757.JPG -> DSC01757).
caption  short editorial line under the frame (default: the capture time)
alt      what is actually in the frame, for screen readers. Please write these.
note     a second line, shown only in the photograph viewer
weight   lead (a full plate) | major (opens a row) | minor (default)
order    a seat number counting from 1; unpinned frames flow around it by capture time
takenAt  2026-08-29T14:20, for a frame whose file lost its EXIF (camera wall clock)
featured true opens the journal with this photograph (the first one wins)
hidden   true keeps the file in the repo but off the page
A caption written against an old filename follows the photograph when a
higher-resolution version replaces it. See /admin/photos for what needs work.
